entries.question: I’m a 2nd year psychology bachelor’s student I want to do a 1 month internship what should I do how to apply
entries.answer:
To apply for a 1-month internship at King George's Medical University (KGMU) as a psychology student, you should generally follow these steps:

1. **Check Eligibility & Departments:** Look into departments relevant to your field, such as the Department of Psychiatry or the Department of Geriatric Mental Health. 
2. **Prepare Documentation:** Prepare an application letter stating your academic background (2nd year B.A./B.Sc. Psychology), the desired duration (1 month), and your learning objectives. You will typically need a formal recommendation letter or "No Objection Certificate" (NOC) from your current college or university.
3. **Contact the Department / Administrative Office:** 
   - Visit the official department page or contact the office of the department you wish to intern with. 
   - You can review departmental details and faculty contacts via the [KGMU Departments Directory](https://www.kgmu.org/department.php).
4. **Submit Your Request:** Submit your application along with your resume/CV and university ID to the department head or administrative section for formal approval. 

For official guidelines and updates, please check the [KGMU Guidelines Page](https://kgmu.org/guidelines.php) or reach out through the [KGMU Main Website](https://www.kgmu.org).

entries.question: OPD appointment
entries.answer:

You can use any of the following booking methods:

1. **Online via ORS:** Visit the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in) portal, select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select the department, date, and time, fill in the patient details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your appointment slip.
2. **ABHA/Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same state and hospital selection workflow.
3. **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS in the format `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Visit the hospital with your Aadhaar number and an active mobile number to generate an OTP, collect a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip. *(Note: The parchi/ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp).*

**Important OPD Timings:**
- Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
- Saturday: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM
- Sundays: Closed

*Help Desk / Contact Numbers:* 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333. 

*(Note: Patients coming from outside the city must bring a valid referral for the specific department.)*

   * मोबाइल नंबर और OTP के माध्यम से रजिस्टर करें और ORS की तरह ही प्रक्रिया का पालन करें।

3. **SMS द्वारा:**
   * `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` लिखकर **8887019134** पर भेजें।

4. **वॉक-इन (अस्पताल आकर):**
   * अपना आधार कार्ड और एक्टिव मोबाइल नंबर लेकर आएं। 
   * काउंटर पर OTP वेरीफाई करें, फिजिकल टोकन लें, ₹50 शुल्क का भुगतान करें और OPD पर्ची प्राप्त करें।

**महत्वपूर्ण बातें:**
* OPD पर्ची का शुल्क सभी बुकिंग विधियों के लिए **₹50** है।
* OPD का समय: सोमवार से शुक्रवार सुबह 9:00 AM से दोपहर 1:00 PM तक और शनिवार को सुबह 9:00 AM से दोपहर 12:00 PM तक (रविवार को बंद)।
* परची/टिकट काउंटर दोपहर 1:00 बजे बंद हो जाता है।
* शहर से बाहर के मरीजों को संबंधित विभाग के लिए वैध रेफरल पर्ची (Referral slip) साथ लानी होगी। 
* लंबी प्रतीक्षा से बचने के लिए पहले से बुकिंग करना अत्यधिक अनुशंसित है।

entries.question: I have UHId too
entries.answer:
Having a UHID (Unique Health Identification) makes your registration process even faster! When booking through the [ORS GOV IN](https://ors.gov.in) portal or at the physical walk-in counters, you can enter or quote your existing UHID so your previous medical records and patient history are automatically linked to your new appointment. 

Just choose your preferred booking method (such as the ORS portal, mobile app, or walk-in registration) and provide your UHID when prompted. Remember that online registration is mandatory, the OPD slip fee is ₹50, and the counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.

entries.question: Opd ke liye online number kaise lgaye
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD ke liye online appointment (number lagane) ke liye aap in tareeqon ka istemal kar sakte hain:

1. **ORS Portal (Online Registration System):**
   - Sabse pehle [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jayein.
   - Apna state (Uttar Pradesh) aur hospital mein KGMU select karein.
   - 'New Appointment' par click karke department, date aur time chunein.
   - Apni patient details bharein aur ₹50 ki online slip fee ka bhugtan karein.
   - Slip download kar lein.

2. **ABHA / Health Care App:**
   - Mobile number aur OTP ke zariye app par register karein aur wahi state/hospital selection flow follow karein.

3. **SMS ke zariye:**
   - Aap `Appointment [Patient Name]` likh kar **8887019134** par SMS bhej sakte hain.

**Zaroori Baatein:**
- Online registration karna anivarya (mandatory) hai.
- OPD slip ka shulk ₹50 hai.
- Bahar ke shahar ke mareezon ko sambhandhit vibhag (department) ka valid referral sath lana hoga.
- OPD ka samay: Somvaar se Shukravaar subah 9:00 AM se dopahar 1:00 PM tak aur Shanivaar subah 9:00 AM se dopahar 12:00 PM tak (Ravivar ko OPD band rehti hai).

For a referred patient on a ventilator needing critical emergency care at KGMU:

1. **Direct Admission Route:** Go directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** for general emergency and critical care admissions, or the relevant specialty emergency unit (such as LARI Cardiology for cardiac emergencies). 
2. **First 24 Hours:** KGMU provides free medicines and supplies for the first 24 hours of emergency treatment.
3. **Contact Emergency PRO:** For immediate coordination and patient welfare assistance at the Trauma Centre, you can contact the PRO Office at **9453004209** or the Patient Welfare Office at **8887019133**.

*Disclaimer: I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.*
